title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Part 2: Particular Requirements - Section 1: Electric Water Heaters
boundary: Electric storage and instant water heaters up to 315 litres capacity and rated voltage not exceeding 250V
description: Requirements covering construction, heating, safety and marking for electric water heaters
clause_1_content: Scope: This standard covers electric water heaters, including instantaneous and storage types, with capacity up to 315 litres.
clause_2_content: General requirements: appliances shall be so designed as to prevent risk of electrical shock, fire and mechanical injury during normal use.
clause_3_content: Marking: each appliance shall be marked with the IS number, rated voltage, wattage, capacity and manufacturer details.

title: Safety of Household Appliances - Part 2 - Section 3: Electric Kettles and Similar Appliances
boundary: Electric kettles, coffee makers and similar water-heating utensils
description: Safety requirements and test methods for electric kettles and similar appliances
clause_1_content: Scope: covers electric kettles, jugs and similar appliances for heating liquids.
clause_2_content: Definitions apply in line with IS 302-1.
clause_3_content: General: appliances must comply with the requirements for heating elements and thermal protection.

title: Safety of Household Appliances - Part 2 - Section 6: Electric Ranges, Ovens and Cooking Ranges
boundary: Electric ranges, ovens, grills and similar cooking appliances
description: Safety requirements for electric cooking appliances
clause_1_content: Scope: covers electrically operated cooking appliances for household use.
clause_2_content: Construction: materials and finishes shall resist corrosion.
clause_3_content: Marking: connection diagrams and ratings shall be legible.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
boundary: High strength deformed bars and wires used in reinforced concrete
description: Specification for Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550 grades of TMT bars
clause_1_content: Scope: applies to high strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement.
clause_2_content: Material: chemical composition limits for carbon, sulphur and phosphorus.
clause_3_content: Mechanical properties: 0.2% proof stress and elongation requirements per grade.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - 33 Grade
boundary: Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) 33 grade for general construction
description: Composition, physical and chemical requirements of OPC 33 grade
clause_1_content: Scope: covers production, sampling and testing of OPC 33 grade cement.
clause_2_content: Chemical requirements: limits on magnesia, sulphur trioxide and loss on ignition.
clause_3_content: Physical requirements: fineness, setting time, soundness and compressive strength.

title: Safety of Household Electrical Appliances - Part 1: General Requirements
boundary: General requirements for the safety of household electrical appliances
description: Framework standard defining general safety clauses for all IS 302 appliance standards
clause_1_content: Scope: general safety principles for household appliances.
clause_2_content: Protection against electric shock at normal temperature.
clause_3_content: Heating based on rated voltages and ambient conditions.
revision_summary: Updated to align with latest IEC 60335-1

title: Bicycle Tyres and Tubes
description: Specification for pneumatic bicycle tyres and inner tubes
clause_1_content: Scope: covers bicycle tyres for rim sizes 400-700 mm.
clause_3_content: Marking: size designation and pressure rating visibility.

title: LED (Light Emitting Diode) / LED Module based Lamps and Luminaires
boundary: LED lamps for general lighting under the CRS scheme
description: Quality requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps and luminaires
clause_1_content: Scope: covers self-ballasted LED lamps with ratings up to 250 V.
clause_2_content: Performance: lumen output, power factor and colour rendering requirements.
clause_3_content: Marking: IS number, wattage, luminous flux and manufacturer details on the lamp.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
boundary: PVC insulated cables, sheathed and unsheathed, single and multicore
description: Specification for PVC insulated cables for household and industrial wiring
clause_1_content: Scope: covers PVC insulated cables used in power and lighting circuits.
clause_2_content: Conductors: copper or aluminium conductor requirements.
clause_3_content: Insulation: PVC insulation thickness and electrical strength.

title: Protective Helmets for Road Users - Specification
description: Safety helmets for use by motorised two-wheeler riders
clause_1_content: Scope: covers protective helmets worn by motorcyclists and scooter riders.
clause_2_content: Materials: shell, liner, retention system requirements.
clause_3_content: Performance: impact attenuation, penetration resistance and strap strength tests.
revision_summary: Mandatory BIS certification enforced from notification date

title: Domestic Electric Washing Machines
boundary: Electric washing machines for household use
description: Requirements for automatic and semi-automatic domestic washing machines
clause_1_content: Scope: covers electrically operated clothes washing machines.
clause_2_content: Performance: washing performance, rinsing and moisture retention requirements.
clause_3_content: Safety and marking requirements per IS 302-1.

title: UG Fuel Tanks for Fixed Diesel Engines
boundary: Fuel tanks for diesel engines used in tractors and other agricultural machinery
description: Specification for fuel tanks with steel construction and quality requirements
clause_1_content: Scope: covers fuel tanks for fixed diesel engines.
clause_3_content: Testing: drop test and pressure test requirements.
